title: Return-to-Brand Wear Forgiveness Cap for Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Customers
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — wear forgiveness cap for customers returning to the Kestrel brand**

**Clause.** The wear forgiveness cap of a turn-in is the tier's loyalty wear forgiveness cap when the customer holds an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract whose contract date falls within 90 calendar days before or after the turn-in date and that shows days past due of 0, or an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract meeting the same two conditions. It is halfway between the tier's wear forgiveness cap and its loyalty wear forgiveness cap when no contract meets both conditions but an active Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract or an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract has its contract date within that window. In every other case the lease keeps the wear forgiveness cap of its tier. The tier's wear forgiveness cap and its loyalty wear forgiveness cap enter wear forgiveness only as this cap schedule assigns them; meeting the loyalty condition alone does not put the loyalty cap in place.

**Reading the customer's contracts.** Where the customer's records for one of these products list more than one active contract, the first active contract listed is the one read. The days between the turn-in date and a contract date are counted in calendar days in either direction, the later date counted and the earlier one not; a contract dated 90 days from the turn-in date is within the window, one dated 91 days away is not.

**Qualifying account number on the waiver.** When the cap is the loyalty cap or the halfway cap, the wear forgiveness waiver carries as its qualifying account number the account number of the contract that meets that cap's conditions, an active new-vehicle retail contract taking precedence over an active balloon contract when both meet them. When the cap is the tier's wear forgiveness cap, the qualifying account number is left empty.

**Caps by tier**

| Tier | Loyalty wear forgiveness cap | Halfway cap |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | $500 | $250 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | $500 | $250 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | $750 | $500 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | $750 | $500 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | $1000 | $750 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | $1500 | $1125 |

**Combinations (hypothetical contracts; window 90 days either side of the turn-in date)**

| Active new-vehicle retail contract | Active balloon contract | Cap | Qualifying account number |
|---|---|---|---|
| dated 30 days after turn-in, 0 days past due | none | loyalty | the retail contract's |
| dated 30 days after, 12 days past due | dated 60 days before, 0 days past due | loyalty | the balloon contract's |
| dated 30 days after, 12 days past due | none | halfway | the retail contract's |
| dated 20 days before, 0 days past due | dated 10 days after, 0 days past due | loyalty | the retail contract's |
| dated 200 days before | none | the tier's wear forgiveness cap | empty |
| none | none | the tier's wear forgiveness cap | empty |
